name: OpenRouter
verifyEndpoint: GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/key with 'Authorization: Bearer KEY' (returns 401 without a valid key, verified; /models is public and does not prove a key)

freeModels.label: Free Models Router
freeModels.note: auto-picks a free model; most stable id

limits: ':free' models: 20 RPM; 50 req/day if under 10 credits purchased all-time, 1000/day at 10+. https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/limits
training: Prompts not logged by default; providers that log/train are excluded unless the user enables the training toggle in privacy settings. Free-model-specific policy not found; check https://openrouter.ai/settings/privacy. Unverified for free endpoints.
terms: OAuth flow exists precisely so apps get a user-owned key (https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/auth/oauth); BYOK documented in FAQ. No prohibition found. Free-model list is volatile: fetch it live.

authorizeQuery.callback_url: your URL; for desktop use http://localhost:PORT/callback; omit for headless
authorizeQuery.code_challenge: base64url(SHA256(verifier)); optional but recommended, required for headless
authorizeQuery.code_challenge_method: S256 (recommended) or plain; must match step 2
authorizeQuery.state: optional, echoed back on callback (not in headless or on deny)

oauth.callbackResult: redirect to callback_url?code=...&state=...; headless shows the code on the page; code is single-use and expires in 10 minutes

body.code_verifier: original verifier if challenge was used

tokenExchange.response: JSON with a 'key' field (docs show only { key }; other fields undocumented)
tokenExchange.errors: 400 Invalid code_challenge_method; 403 Invalid code or code_verifier; 403 code expired; 405 not POST

oauth.localhost: Documented: 'Localhost callbacks are supported on any port' (example http://localhost:51423/callback). Localhost apps show as host:port and are not listed in marketplace/rankings. CORS preflight to /api/v1/auth/keys returns 204 with allow-origin *.

listFreeModels: GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (public, 456 models today): a model is free when pricing.prompt==='0' and pricing.completion==='0'; free chat variants have ids ending ':free'. Filter by supported_parameters includes 'tools' for agent use. Verified live 2026-10-28 (16 :free ids returned).
